# D03 矩阵可逆的等价条件

完整知识单元课堂参考草稿，按数学内容选择组织方式。本示例仅供理解教学行为，实际项目应重新设计板书、布局、动画和节奏；关联题规则以当前项目为准。以下代码尚未经过真实成片验收。

```python title=scene_01
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class D03Part1(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("矩阵可逆的等价条件", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("D03_1_1", "对 n 阶方阵 A，可逆、行列式非零、秩等于 n、齐次方程只有零解是等价条件。", "", tts_text="对 n 阶方阵 A，可逆、行列式非零、秩等于 n、齐次方程只有零解是等价条件。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"A^{-1}\ \text{exists}\iff |A|\ne0\iff r(A)=n", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D03_1_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("D03_1_1")
        self.start_cue("D03_1_2", "还可以从线性方程组的唯一性角度理解。", "", tts_text="还可以从线性方程组的唯一性角度理解。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"Ax=0\Rightarrow x=0", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D03_1_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("D03_1_2")
```

```python title=scene_02
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class D03Part2(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("矩阵可逆的等价条件", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("D03_2_1", "若 A 可逆，两边乘逆矩阵即可推出齐次方程只有零解。", "", tts_text="若 A 可逆，两边乘逆矩阵即可推出齐次方程只有零解。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"Ax=0\Rightarrow x=A^{-1}0=0", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D03_2_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("D03_2_1")
        self.start_cue("D03_2_2", "若齐次方程只有零解，由秩与自由变量的关系，秩必须等于 n。", "", tts_text="若齐次方程只有零解，由秩与自由变量的关系，秩必须等于 n。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"n-r(A)=0\Rightarrow r(A)=n", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D03_2_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("D03_2_2")
        self.start_cue("D03_2_3", "满秩方阵可经初等行变换化为单位阵，因初等矩阵均可逆，A 可逆。", "", tts_text="满秩方阵可经初等行变换化为单位阵，因初等矩阵均可逆，A 可逆。")
        line_3 = MathTex(r"E_k\cdots E_1A=I", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_3.next_to(line_2, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_3), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D03_2_3", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2, line3=line_3)
        self.end_cue("D03_2_3")
        self.start_cue("D03_2_4", "可逆时行列式乘积等于一，所以行列式不为零；反向用伴随矩阵公式。", "", tts_text="可逆时行列式乘积等于一，所以行列式不为零；反向用伴随矩阵公式。")
        self.play(FadeOut(line_1), FadeOut(line_2), FadeOut(line_3), run_time=min(0.35, self.cue_time_left()*0.15))
        line_4 = MathTex(r"|A|\ne0\Rightarrow A^{-1}=\frac{A^*}{|A|}", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_4, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_4), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D03_2_4", heading=heading, line1=line_4)
        self.end_cue("D03_2_4")
```

```python title=scene_03
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class D03Part3(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("矩阵可逆的等价条件", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("D03_3_1", "例题：判断这个二阶方阵何时可逆。", "", tts_text="例题：判断这个二阶方阵何时可逆。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"A=\begin{pmatrix}1&t\\2&4\end{pmatrix}", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D03_3_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("D03_3_1")
        self.start_cue("D03_3_2", "计算行列式，等于四减二 t。", "", tts_text="计算行列式，等于四减二 t。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"|A|=4-2t", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D03_3_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("D03_3_2")
        self.start_cue("D03_3_3", "行列式不等于零，等价于 t 不等于二。", "", tts_text="行列式不等于零，等价于 t 不等于二。")
        line_3 = MathTex(r"t\ne2", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_3.next_to(line_2, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_3), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D03_3_3", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2, line3=line_3)
        self.end_cue("D03_3_3")
```
